template: Maximum security deposit of one month's rent; optional fee in lieu of deposit applies to this address. Source: M.G.L. c. 186, § 15B(1)(b)(iii), (1)(d); as of 2026-10-01. Not legal advice.
rewrite: For this address, the security deposit can be no more than one month's rent, and an optional fee in place of a deposit also applies. Source: M.G.L. c. 186, § 15B(1)(b)(iii), (1)(d); as of 2026-10-01. Not legal advice.
